extension.summary: Default playback speed per series, library, or globally
extension.description: Sets the playback speed when a video starts. The most specific default wins: series, then library (e.g. separate Jellyfin libraries for anime and TV shows), then the global default. You can still change the speed of a single episode while it plays, and optionally save it as the series default.[CR][CR]Speed changes need "Sync playback to display" (Settings → Player → Videos). The add-on can turn it on for you.
